entries.headline: Coded radio traffic spike reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported four coded U.S. military radio transmissions in one hour and said activity across nine global regions was nearly seven times its normal level. The post did not disclose message contents.

entries.headline: Transport and command aircraft active
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States, along with one coded Air Force broadcast. The update also repeated its earlier Tu-95MS crash report.

entries.headline: Bomber and military aircraft tracked
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force bomber, multiple transport aircraft and one reconnaissance aircraft airborne over the United States, with several senior-support military aircraft observed near Washington, D.C. The post did not identify the aircraft.

entries.headline: USAF transport and reconnaissance activity
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and one reconnaissance aircraft airborne over the United States, along with one coded radio broadcast heard during the day. The post did not identify the aircraft or broadcast code.

entries.headline: US command and surveillance aircraft tracked
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported U.S. military surveillance and command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, two NATO radar aircraft detected, and one coded Air Force broadcast heard. No aircraft identities or purpose were confirmed.

entries.headline: Tu-95MS crash reported in Amur
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported that a Russian Tu-95MS bomber crashed during takeoff in Amur on a training flight and described the aircraft as a total loss. The visible post did not state a cause.

entries.headline: Transport and surveillance aircraft tracked
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported U.S. military transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the continental United States and the North Sea, plus one coded Air Force radio broadcast heard. No aircraft identities or broadcast code were given.

entries.headline: Navy carrier landing incident relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an AP report that two U.S. Navy aviators ejected during a carrier landing off Virginia and four sailors were injured. The post attributed the report to AP via @reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF aircraft and coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. Air Force surveillance and transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Europe, with coded radio traffic detected earlier that day. The post did not identify the aircraft or message content.

entries.headline: EAM header reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel posted the header code K774XT in its HFGCS monitoring feed. The code alone does not reveal the message’s purpose.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 reported at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida. The alert gives no callsign and does not confirm its mission or reason for landing.

entries.headline: Separate P-8 ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: A separate SkyGlass alert also reported a P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida. With no callsign shown, the posts do not establish whether they concern the same aircraft.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Cape Canaveral
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Cape Canaveral, United States. The alert records the tracked type and departure status without confirming a destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Abu Dhabi
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The alert gives no callsign and does not confirm its operator, destination or purpose.

entries.headline: EAGLE31 E-2 reported at Port Hueneme
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported E-2 callsign EAGLE31 on the ground at Port Hueneme, California. The alert records the tracked location and status without confirming a mission.

entries.headline: B-52 departure near Minden
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a B-52 off the ground at Minden, Louisiana. The alert records the tracked type and departure status without confirming its destination or tasking.

entries.headline: RFR7049 P-8 departure at Plainfield
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported P-8 callsign RFR7049 off the ground at Plainfield, Indiana. The alert identifies UK registration but does not confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: NATO02 E3TF reported at Albacete
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported NATO02, an E3TF aircraft, on the ground at Albacete, Spain. The alert identifies its registration as Luxembourg; it does not confirm why it was there.

entries.headline: P-8 reported at Oak Grove
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 on the ground at Oak Grove, South Carolina. The alert gives the tracked type and location but does not confirm its operator, mission, or reason for landing.

entries.headline: B-1 reported at Highworth
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a B-1 on the ground at Highworth, United Kingdom. The alert gives its tracked type and location but does not establish when it arrived or why it was there.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Orange Park, Florida. The alert gives the tracked type and departure status but does not confirm a mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Bellair-Meadowbrook
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Bellair-Meadowbrook Terrace, Florida. The alert records the tracked type and departure status without confirming a destination or mission.
